subject.title: feat: add native inline widget support

question: Should native operator sessions receive a narrowly scoped way to rotate their own Canvas capability, or should inline widgets be advertised only when a node session can own refresh?
rationale: The current gateway contract makes refresh node-only, but the PR advertises the feature on operator sessions; choosing the permanent refresh owner changes authorization policy and native product availability.

options.title: Add operator-owned refresh
options.body: Allow an authenticated operator session to rotate only its own Canvas capability and cover operator-only expiry and reconnect races.

options.title: Require a node refresh owner
options.body: Do not advertise inline widgets unless a live node session can mint and refresh the route, accepting reduced native availability.

recommendation.title: Add operator-owned refresh
recommendation.body: Allow an authenticated operator session to rotate only its own Canvas capability and cover operator-only expiry and reconnect races.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature and most relevant native gateway history are concentrated in this person’s current-main work.
